# Native mobile follow-ups selective release

Release SHA:        f0b87817598b6699eb9b407d4d1f304cb55694ec

- Release PR: https://github.com/mposition/Tomverse/pull/2956
- Goal-Step: NATIVE-01/mobile-followups
- Source: develop PR #2952, merge `28249162694276432b6c421ed7c116452f1b085a`.
- Production base: `0b740935a0076bbfcf0c80433a5f25349dba8e0f`.
- Application candidate: the Release SHA above; the final RC is the release PR head, including this record.
- Rollback: `0b740935a0076bbfcf0c80433a5f25349dba8e0f`, Railway deployment `67f86c5d-7d43-415f-92a3-1cc34aacd753`; public build-info and health HTTP 200 confirmed on 2026-10-24.

The operator explicitly approved a dedicated selective release for #2952 only, including the zod 4.6.7, undici 7.30.1 and fast-uri 3.1.9 security updates. No other develop feature is selected. Main's Next.js 16.4.2 and Sentry 10.75.2 versions are retained. The complete application patch matches the locally verified main-based candidate after rebase.

The release adds the bundled native app's compact history, canonical search and filters, projects, pinning, sharing, exports, password locks and confirmed deletion. It also fixes titles, effective Easy Review defaults, account usage, startup, mobile Enter behavior and device verification frequency, and permits screenshots. Existing handlers, ownership checks and approved native bearer boundaries are reused.

- [x] The #2952 source head passed all 31 checks before its develop merge.
- [x] The main-based application candidate passed 92 focused server/transport/security tests, 71 mobile browser scenarios, root/mobile TypeScript and the mobile build.
- [x] Production dependency audit at the application candidate reported zero vulnerabilities.
- [x] Android APK assembly, signature verification, update installation and cold launch passed on API 36 without AndroidRuntime errors. Assets are locally bundled; no remote website URL or source maps are included.
- [x] The exact develop merge deployed successfully as `e5ce64ac-f17f-484e-b9c7-a4afca5a024f`; public dev build-info returned `28249162694276432b6c421ed7c116452f1b085a`.
- [x] On that dev deployment, health returned 200; 13 native capability/usage/history/project routes rejected an invalid bearer with `401 MOBILE_TOKEN_INVALID` and the approved local-app CORS origin. History preflight returned 204 with unlock/time-zone headers; an untrusted origin received no CORS grant.

Accepted authentication-boundary reviews `r-20261024-073008-cb126e` and `r-20261024-061623-8c9538` are reused: this record and the dependency patches do not alter the reviewed boundary.

The initial draft-event Actions suites were cancelled; their aggregate jobs failed because upstream jobs were cancelled, without a failed test step. Replacement Ready-event results do not erase those suites, so `promote:test --dry-run` correctly refused that application SHA. This record creates a final release candidate that must obtain its own complete required CI. No cancelled suite is treated as passing and no CI gate is waived.

Exact final-head CI, Test deployment SUCCESS/build-info and runtime evidence must be recorded in the PR before merge. Production SUCCESS/build-info, approved native API activation and the main-to-develop back-merge must be recorded after release. Invalid-bearer/CORS probes establish server rejection and transport behavior; they do not establish an authenticated user's successful usage/history actions. iOS Xcode/device verification remains outstanding on the Windows build host.

Paid model/voice calls, production voice activation and store submission remain outside this release's authorization. No such call or activation was used for these checks.
